title: stumpid (identity verification)
summary: Optional Ed25519 identity proof for RRC. Lets a client (e.g. Firefly) prove it's the same identity across reconnects and transports, and lets the operator require that proof before writes.

activation.note: No manual activation needed -- example_node.py's load_plugins() discovers any folder with an install.py and calls activate() automatically. Order relative to fservbot does not matter for CORRECTNESS -- each plugin captures whatever is currently bound to rrc.handle_input, so wraps compose regardless of order. It DOES matter for which plugin ends up OUTERMOST: alphabetical discovery activates 'stumpid' after 'fservbot', which is required here since gating a write means intercepting it before anything else acts on it. A future plugin sorting ahead of 'stumpid' that also wants to gate writes would need this reconsidered.
activation.removal: Delete the two lines and the stumpid/ folder. AUTH_MODE has no effect once the wrapper is gone -- every client is treated as it always was, by client_id alone.

requires_note: No hard dependency. If fservbot is installed and has an operator password set, /admin reuses it -- one password, two capabilities, nothing new to remember. If fservbot is absent or has no password, stumpid falls back to its own AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Either plugin can be removed without breaking the other.

wizard.note: Most nodes want 'open' -- this only matters once a client that mints real identities (like Firefly) is expected to visit.

prompts.help: hybrid: reads open, writes need a verified identity. mandatory: everything but /auth and /whoami needs one.

prompts.prompt: Admin password for /admin (blank = reuse fservbot's, if any)
